theorems.name: Submission.tendsto_integral_tangentialDiv_of_tendstoUniformly_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (X : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (Y : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsCompact K → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → tsupport X ⊆ K → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ K) → TendstoUniformly (fun k ↦ fderiv ℝ (Y k)) (fderiv ℝ X) atTop → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ x, V.tangentialDiv (Y k) x ∂V.weight) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, V.tangentialDiv X x ∂V.weight))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
